note: Commit timestamps (committer date, +08:00) of the development repository. The commit hashes refer to the private development history; the public release is a sanitized export and does not contain these commits. `verification` distinguishes (A) programmatic verification, (B) AI-assisted technical review and (C) the human project-owner review; (A) and (B) are not human sign-offs, and no independent human third-party audit has occurred. `reviews` records review verdicts, which are not commits.

reviews.label: AI-assisted technical cross-check and independent numerical recomputation
reviews.scope: source code, raw PCB3 score files, threshold files, the analysis-repair diff, website content and visual-QA screenshots; PCB3 thresholds, confusion matrices, recall, FPR, holdout false alarms, AUROC, perturbation false alarms and the G1 difference-in-differences (with a separate paired bootstrap) recomputed from the raw CSV files
reviews.verdict: AI-assisted cross-check passed, subject to delivery refinements; recomputed results agree with the project reports; post-evaluation repair 7dbd302 judged non-score-affecting, disclosure must remain. Not a human sign-off; project-owner acceptance pending; public release not authorized.
limitations: Raw numerical metrics were recomputed from the recorded score files; the models were not re-run.
The AI-assisted review did not execute the complete local PyTorch test suite.
The original private development history could not be independently reproduced from the sanitized GitHub snapshot alone.
Some verification checks require the locally stored VisA dataset or the private development history.

reviews.label: AI-assisted review of the owner-handoff package
reviews.date_note: date the review decision was recorded in this repository; the review's own completion time was not recorded
reviews.scope: repository visibility, main unchanged, model scoring code and recorded PCB3 scores unchanged, executive PDF page counts, exclusion of audit material, nature of changes since the prior snapshot
reviews.verdict: Passed with one mandatory correction: review-provenance wording that could imply an independent human engineering audit (corrected 2026-10-10, reporting text only). Project-owner acceptance pending; external publication not authorized.

verification.A_programmatic: `python -m ivad check` recomputes every PCB1/PCB2 metric from the per-image score files and traces every number in both executive PDFs to a recorded output; `python verification/recompute_pcb3.py` (imports no project code) recomputes every PCB3 number from the raw score files: 90/90 checks agree (reports/pcb3_verification/recompute.md).
verification.B_ai_assisted_review: Implementation and initial verification artifacts were produced by Claude Code (AI coding assistant). Additional AI-assisted reviews examined code and documentation, and one AI-assisted reviewer independently recomputed the principal PCB3 metrics and the paired robustness statistic from the raw score files on the private GitHub review branch (see `reviews`).
